#29295

ORDINANCE Nov F 202%

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all of the RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District symbols and

indications as shown on Map No. 3-l in an area bound by:

West Evergreen Avenue; a line 206.13 feet east of and parallel to North California Avenue; the alley next
south of and parallel to West Evergreen Avenue; and the alley next east of and parallel to North California

Avenue.

To those of a RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.

Common Address of Property: 2739 W Evergreen Ave.
